_note: CTCAE grading catalog for the StewardMD onco-ctcae engine. Both CTCAE v5.0 and CTCAE v4.03 editions are fully seeded with official verbatim grade definitions from the US National Cancer Institute (public domain).
gapMessage: Consult the full NCI CTCAE v5.0. This adverse event (or grade) is not seeded in StewardMD.
